race.description: Procon Developments Northam Cup – 25 Oct Hcp (54+)
race.comment: AWESOME FORCE (2) is nearing another win after some solid efforts through the winter. Her form on better tracks is good, and maybe the switch from blinkers to winkers can bring about that overdue success. OBSCENTINO (1) has improved since being tried in front, and he followed up a recent second-place finish with a gritty win by a short head here 10 days ago. Stick with him. ASTONISHER (3) has needed both of his starts back from a spell, and her only win has come when third up from a break. She is on target to figure in the top 3 here. ICANDOIT ONMYOWN (5) flipped her form around when breaking her win drought here 17 days ago over 2200m. She is only up 2kg and she can repeat the dose. TOKYO FIRE (11) has found some form again with a third over this trip here just over 2 weeks ago. She meets a similar field and is worth including in all top 4 combos again.
